purpose: Illustrate a reviewable intermediate representation, not implement an SPI or trade approval decision.

source.normative_role: financial qualification condition within the guidance

temporal_applicability.reason: Publication date is known; full current applicability and imported definitions have not been reviewed.

scope.client_route: individual professional investor route under Annex 1 paragraph 1
scope.corporate_route: Annex 1 paragraph 2 is outside this example

qualifying_portfolio_hkd.note: A portfolio constructed under the imported definitions and ownership rules; not presumed equal to AUM at this bank.

qualifying_net_assets_ex_primary_residen.note: Use the stated assets-minus-liabilities and primary-residence deduction, with reviewed ownership aggregation.

proposed_evaluation_semantics.or: true if any operand is true; false if all operands are false; unknown otherwise
proposed_evaluation_semantics.numbers: exact decimal or rational arithmetic; no binary floating point threshold comparison
proposed_evaluation_semantics.evidence_conflict: Separate evidence_conflict status; do not silently select a value.
proposed_evaluation_semantics.prerequisites: Evaluate only for resolved individual-client scope using valid as-of-date, consistently normalised inputs. This example leaves those mappings unresolved.
proposed_evaluation_semantics.bank_policy_not_source_rule: Any decision to suspend automation or request review because evidence is unresolved requires a separately attributable bank policy.

dependencies_not_implemented.requirement: Professional Investor Rules and Code of Conduct definitions
Professional-investor status, knowledge or experience, and investment objectives
Product category, monitoring approach, exposure history and leverage
Assessment, records, agreement and annual review

dependencies_not_implemented.source: Bank data-mapping policy, to be supplied
dependencies_not_implemented.requirement: Evidence validation, valuation date, currency conversion and prevention of duplicate ownership counting

implementation_status: Illustrative structured data only. No parser, evaluator, compiler, proof or bank-system integration has been implemented.
